mapper.select: SELECT * FROM report_lines WHERE report_type = #{reportType} ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_lines (report_type, line_code, line_name, section, line_kind, formula_expr, sort_order, indent) VALUES (#{reportType}, #{lineCode}, #{lineName}, #{section}, #{lineKind}, #{formulaExpr}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{indent},0))
